basic_info.description: Call for preview. Tucked away on a quiet cul-de-sac in one of San Francisco's most sought-after neighborhoods, this beautifully updated home offers breathtaking views and a sophisticated yet inviting ambiance. Thoughtfully designed with timeless details, the residence features gleaming hardwood floors, custom built-ins, and designer lighting throughout.    The main level is perfect for both everyday living and entertaining, with a gracious living room centered around a stately fireplace, a formal dining room, and a well-appointed powder room. The heart of the home is the expansive kitchen, a chef's dream outfitted with a professional-grade Wolf range and a Sub-Zero side-by-side refrigerator, offering both style and functionality. A dedicated laundry room adds to the home's convenience.    Upstairs, the luxurious primary suite is a serene retreat, complete with bespoke built-ins, a spacious walk-in closet, and a marble-clad spa-like bathroom featuring dual sinks, a soaking tub, and a glass-enclosed shower. Two additional bedrooms on this level share a beautifully renovated bathroom. The lower level provides flexible living options, including an ensuite bedroom with a built-in Murphy bed ideal for guests or a private home office. A spacious garage and ample storage.
